newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK stocks reverse course to rise in morning trade.
newsitem.headline: HK stocks reverse course to rise in morning trade.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks reversed course to move higher on Thursday morning, boosted by the strength of index futures, brokers said.
The blue chip Hang Seng Index was up 29 points, or 0.21 percent, to 14,265 after erasing a 55-point loss at the open.

"People are not daring to sell since the index futures rose so sharply," said Michael Ng, dealing director at Sassoon Securities. May Hang Seng Index futures surged 120 points to 14,335 and June was up 115 to 14,380 in early trade.
Buying was focused on Hongkong Telecom, Swire Pacific and individual red-chips, brokers said.
